subject.title: Feature: TTS delivery mode option — separate text + voice messages on Telegram

question: Should OpenClaw add a public Telegram TTS delivery policy for separate full-width text plus voice-note delivery, and where should that policy live?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the fix creates public config/channel behavior and overlaps with captioned-final and voice-only TTS direction, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
options.body: Define bundled/captioned versus separate behavior, keep existing behavior as the default, and require docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep captioned delivery standard
options.body: Document tagged/manual splitting and overflow fallback as the supported path instead of adding another TTS delivery mode.

options.title: Defer until captioned-final settles
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/83988 or its replacement to land before deciding whether separate delivery should be first-class.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow delivery policy
recommendation.body: Define bundled/captioned versus separate behavior, keep existing behavior as the default, and require docs, tests, and live Telegram proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available history across core TTS policy, Telegram caption delivery, and the config/plugin boundary this decision would touch.
